title: Sei-Sangeet-Bangla
summary: A Bengali music experience set inside an illustrated room, with a song list and a familiar player.
problem: Create a dedicated web experience around Bengali music.
contribution: Developed Sei-Sangeet-Bangla as a personal music project.
features: Browse the song list inside a nostalgic, illustrated Bengali room.
Use track, playback, seek and volume controls in the music player.
note: The project is included in my portfolio, while its source repository remains private.
imageAlt: Sei-Sangeet-Bangla music room with Bengali song list and player

title: Llama 2 GGML Medical Chatbot
summary: An experiment in answering questions from medical reference documents with a quantized language model.
problem: Explore document-grounded question answering using local model inference and retrieved source passages.
contribution: Built the retrieval workflow, model integration and chatbot interface using Python and LangChain.
features: Retrieve document passages using sentence-transformer embeddings and FAISS.
Pass retrieved context to a pretrained Llama 2 model and return source documents with the answer.
note: This is a document-retrieval experiment, not a clinical system or a substitute for professional medical advice. It uses a pretrained model; no model-training or clinical-accuracy claim is made.
imageAlt: Llama 2 medical document retrieval prototype interface

title: TaskFlow
summary: A flexible task board for organizing work, one column and one card at a time.
problem: Keep tasks, priorities and supporting details together in a lightweight visual workflow.
contribution: Built a browser-based task management interface with customizable columns and drag-and-drop task cards.
features: Organize tasks with due dates, priorities, assignees, tags, comments and checklists.
Search tasks, move cards between columns and save the board in browser localStorage.
note: The board is stored in the current browser. Assignee fields help organize work; they do not imply a hosted multi-user collaboration backend.
imageAlt: TaskFlow task cards arranged in To Do, In Progress and Done columns

title: Simon
summary: A browser memory game built around color, sound and an increasingly long sequence to remember.
problem: Recreate the classic Simon memory challenge with immediate visual feedback and simple browser controls.
contribution: Built the game interface, randomized sequence logic, audio feedback and local high-score tracking in JavaScript.
features: Follow flashing colors and repeat the growing sequence to advance through levels.
Hear feedback on button presses and mistakes, restart a round and keep the highest score in the current browser.
note: The high score is saved locally in the current browser. The game is a personal implementation of the classic Simon memory challenge.
